data.query: Ryan’s Barkery All-natural dog treats biscuits
data.answer: Ryan's Barkery is an all-natural dog treat company created by Ryan Kelly, who started the business to make better biscuits for his rescue puppy. The treats are made with ingredients fit for human consumption and are grain-free and vegetarian. Ryan's Barkery has competitors like Denzel's, Shameless Pets, and Ry's Ruffery, and it was featured on Shark Tank. The company's treats include varieties like Peanut Butter, Pumpkin-Apple, and Cheddar. The sources do not provide specific details about the official website or phone number of Ryan's Barkery.

# Ryan Kelly of Ryan’s Barkery and Shark Tank Success – Part 1

Ryan Kelly

Ryan Kelly

Ryan is a young entrepreneur who owns Ryan’s Barkery, a company dedicated to bringing the highest quality and tastiest all-natural treats to dogs everywhere.

It was his adopted dog, Barkley, who ultimately inspired Ryan to start his own business. After adopting him from an animal shelter, his mom and dad stopped at a pet store to buy some tasty treats to welcome Barkley into the family. But, unfortunately, the treats weren’t so welcoming, the smell sent both pet and owners scurrying towards the hills. And that is when Ryan declared he could bake a much better, tastier treat that his dog would love. [...] What are your plans for building your business? Do you see this as a long-term venture into adulthood?

My plans for building my business…now that a lot more people know about my product, I would like to be in more stores so people everywhere can get my treats for their dogs! We are working on new flavors, and a grain free treat for dogs with allergies.

I’m working really hard to make Ryan’s Barkery a long term success! My mom and Barbara and I work closely together, and I’m learning so much.

To learn more about Ryan’s Barkery and their tasty treats for your animal family, please visit Ryan’s website at [...] I would tell someone struggling with math that first of all, everyone struggles with something. Second, I would tell them that something that can help with math is concentration. Distractions make it harder, so turn off the TV and your iPod.

What inspired you to want to make your dog biscuits into a business venture as opposed to a hobby?

I’ve thought of things I could do since I was little. I’ve had lemonade stands, I’ve shoveled walkways, and I’ve sold my Halloween candy on the bus. The difference with a hobby is that you do it when you feel like it. A business is something that you make a promise to do every day. People start to count on it being there. People started looking for my treats at every adoption event, and I needed to make sure they could get them every time they went.

Bark with Buster specializes in the production and wholesale supply of natural, air-dried dog treats within the pet care industry. The company offers a variety of treats including jerky, chews, and biscuits, all made from high-quality Australian meat without artificial flavors, colors, grains, or preservatives. Bark with Buster primarily serves the pet care market, with a focus on dog owners looking for healthy, natural treat options for their pets. It was founded in 2022 and is based in Melbourne, Victoria.
